projects.title: Pump Station 3 telemetry retrofit
projects.summary: Replace the failing PS3 telemetry with a modern SCADA changeover: new RTU, instrument loop checks, commissioning, and revision-controlled procedures throughout.
projects.arc: kickoff at -150d; procedure rev A -120d, rev B -45d, rev C -10d; commissioning window opens +7d; the demo catches the project at its busiest.

projects.title: Vantage fit-out programme, tranche 2
projects.summary: Eight-store fit-out pipeline: surveys, drawings, procurement, install. Lives in tables — pipeline with currency and status columns, budget with a sum aggregate.
projects.arc: tranche 2 running -90d to +60d; two stores at practical completion, one in a snag dispute, five mid-flight.

projects.title: Copperline campus microgrid feasibility
projects.summary: Desk study: can the campus island for four hours? Load profiles, storage sizing, islanding scheme options, and a final report due shortly after seed time.
projects.arc: started -60d; draft findings page in review now; final report due +14d — a live deadline the demo's tasks and chat turns can point at.

projects.title: Workshop lathe restoration

projects.title: Coastal Trail Half training

projects.arc: 3 runs/week; ankle scare -30d; taper begins +7d; race day +21d — a future event the dashboard can show.
